# QrErrorCorrectionLevel

`Flare.Components.QrErrorCorrectionLevel`

QR code error correction level. Higher levels allow more data recovery at the cost of reduced capacity.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `L` | `0` | ~7% of data can be restored. |
| `M` | `1` | ~15% of data can be restored (default). |
| `Q` | `2` | ~25% of data can be restored. |
| `H` | `3` | ~30% of data can be restored. |

## Used by components

- `FlareQrCode`
